meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing with a hybrid engine strategy: resident-kernel engines first - DuckDB plus a resident Python stack (Polars/numpy/matplotlib) in persistent js/py eval kernels where the harness has them, bun/uv one-shots elsewhere - and per-action placement judgment (in-memory vs streaming vs remote-in-place). Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,自动完成统计、聚合与可视化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常处理CSV/JSON等数据文件并需要快速洞察
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files to produce statistics, aggregations, and charts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often process CSV/JSON files and need fast data insights

howto.what: 装上后,面对数据文件,Claude 会先探测数据大小与内存情况,再选择合适引擎:常规查询用 DuckDB,DataFrame 类操作用 Polars,数值计算用 numpy,绘图用 matplotlib;它会报告行数与耗时,不加载超出内存的数据,也不用 pandas。
howto.when: 当你说出「分析数据」、查看 CSV/Parquet/JSON 文件里有什么,或要求做分组、筛选、连接、绘图等数据处理时触发;不用于纯文本/代码检查、配置文件或小型数学计算。

say.text: 帮我看看这个 CSV 里有什么,统计行数和各列类型。
say.note: 会触发文件概览并报告行数。

say.text: 把这两份数据按 id 合并,再展示每天的变化趋势。
say.note: 会触发连接与聚合操作。

say.text: 给销量画直方图,完成后再做一次可视化检查。
say.note: 会按可视化规范出图并检查。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude probes data size and memory, picks an engine (DuckDB/Polars/numpy/matplotlib), reports row counts and timing, never loads beyond-RAM data, and avoids pandas.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to 'analyze the data', inspect CSV/Parquet/JSON contents, or request grouping, filtering, joins, plotting, etc. Not for plain text/code inspection or tiny inline math.

say_en.text: What's in this CSV? Give row count and column types.
Join these two datasets by id and show the daily trend.
Plot a histogram of sales and do the visual check.
say_en.note: Creates chart following the visualization spec.
